sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_discovery_cycles WHERE started_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 14:11:04.815743+00') AS cycles, (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_discovery_cycles WHERE started_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 14:11:04.815743+00' AND errors > 0) AS cycles_with_errors, (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_shadow_quotes WHERE placed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 14:11:04.815743+00') AS quotes, (SELECT count(*) FROM incentive_shadow_outcomes WHERE ended_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 14:11:04.815743+00' AND fill_model = 'conservative') AS outcomes_conservative, (SELECT count(DISTINCT program_id) FROM incentive_programs WHERE last_seen_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-17 14:11:04.815743+00') AS programs_observed
